title: GateProposal
description: HS-104-02: a tool-call gate proposal on the wire (POST/GET /api/gate/proposals). The record is a proposal, never authority — only the live hook waiting on the decision can let the call proceed. Arguments are redacted at the agent edge: sha256 + first 120 characters, never the full payload. States: held (the only non-terminal), approved, denied, expired, invalidated. Spec artifact for the future Swift recreation.

id.description: Idempotency key minted by the hook, once per invocation.

expires_at.description: Epoch seconds; expiry is a deny, never an allow.

reason.description: Rides back to the agent verbatim on deny.
